The EU-harmonised annual inflation rate in Germany stood at 2.9% in August 2026, in line with preliminary estimates and up slightly from July's 2.8%. It was the highest reading since April.
The Consumer Price Index increased 0.20% in August of 2026 over the previous month, matching estimates.

title: Germany’s annual inflation rises to 2.9% in August
